hero_kpi_rationale: The company's primary revenue, generated from aircraft leasing, represents more than 80% of total revenue and is the fundamental driver of its business model.

kpis.name: Lease Revenue

kpis.description: Lease revenue is the cornerstone of AerCap's business model, showing year-on-year growth.

risks.title: Dependence on a few aircraft manufacturers
risks.score_rationale: The risk is highlighted centrally in the 10-K, with strong language ("rely on a small number of manufacturers"). The trend is stable, but supply shortages and supply chain issues persist. This category weighs heavily on AerCap's business model.

risks.title: Increased competition in aircraft leasing
risks.score_rationale: The risk is clearly identified in the 10-K with assertive language ("significant competition"). The trend is stable, but the sector is attracting new entrants. Competition directly affects leasing rates and placement capacity.

risks.title: Growing environmental regulation
risks.score_rationale: The risk is well positioned in the document, with concerned language ("may be supplemented by additional regulations"). The trend is upward, linked to ESG pressures. It affects the future value of assets.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of information systems
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned with alert language ("damaged or interrupted, including by cyberattack"). The trend is upward. Critical systems depend on digital continuity.

risks.title: Adoption of artificial intelligence
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in a dedicated section, with cautious language ("may result in operational errors"). The trend is upward. It is an emerging risk related to digital transformation.

risks.title: Increased regulation on trade and sanctions
risks.score_rationale: The risk is strongly emphasized, particularly with sanctions related to the Ukraine conflict. Intense language and strategic positioning in the document. Trend is upward in a tense geopolitical context.

risks.title: Maintenance and insurance by lessees
risks.score_rationale: The risk is clearly stated with language of dependency ("depend on our lessees to properly maintain"). Trend is stable. It directly impacts asset integrity and future costs.

ai_positioning.summary: AerCap does not mention any initiatives related to artificial intelligence in its recent financial reports. The company focuses on its traditional aircraft leasing activities.
evidence: No mention of AI in the 10-K
No references to innovative technology projects
